content.title: One pure-Go rendering pipeline
content.lede: The public Document and ImageDocument models map into one shared pipeline: load -> html -> css -> prepare -> layout -> paginate -> paint -> write. internal/convert orchestrates PDF jobs; internal/imageout reuses the same front half for one PNG/JPEG canvas.

content.heading: Conversion flow
items: Root Document / ImageDocument -> Content validation and an owned copy at the write boundary.
Shared front half: load -> html -> css -> prepare (stylesheet collection and @font-face merge).
layout builds the display list; PaintContext paginates it for PDF while image mode rasterizes the same display-list ops onto one canvas.
PDF: internal/convert owns headers/footers, TOC, outline, links, copies, and document info over internal/pdf (PDF 1.4 default; opt-in 1.7 / 2.0 profiles).
Image: internal/imageout writes PNG/JPEG bytes; internal/svg rasterizes SVG-as-img before layout treats it as pixels.
internal/outline turns headings into an outline tree / dump XML without PDF or layout types.
Entry points: root library; cmd/gowkhtmltopdf and cmd/gowkhtmltoimage through internal/cli and internal/app; bindings/wasm for the browser; bindings/c and bindings/python for in-process embedders.

content.heading: Ownership
rows: Root package
Typed model, source validation, callbacks, writer and byte APIs (api.go, document.go, document_validate.go)
cmd/gowkhtmltopdf, cmd/gowkhtmltoimage
Thin mains; argv grammar in internal/cli, command-to-engine adapters in internal/app
bindings/wasm
Browser adapter: inline HTML request, browser-safe policy, JavaScript bridge; no native file or URL sources
bindings/c, bindings/python
In-process C ABI v1 and ctypes Python bindings over Document.WritePDF / ImageDocument.WriteImage
internal/load
Primary document and subresource fetch under ACL, NetworkPolicy, timeouts, redirect limits, and body caps
internal/html, internal/css
Tolerant parse (no script execution) and CSS subset with cascade plus media/container queries
internal/layout
Style resolve, block/inline/table/flex/grid/float, display list, PaintContext pagination
internal/convert (+ prepare, render)
PDF hub: prepare -> render.RenderObjects -> Assemble -> Finalize; headers/footers, TOC, links, copies, document info
internal/pdf
Version-aware writer: TTF subset, Type0/CID, images, annotations, outlines, tagged structure
internal/imageout, internal/svg
PNG/JPEG raster sink and SVG-as-img rasterization (tdewolff/canvas)
internal/outline, internal/settings, internal/pdfprofile
Heading outline tree, dotted settings and page sizes, conformance profile tokens

content.title: Security boundary
content.body: Local files are blocked by default. The --allow-local-files CLI flag or Document.AllowLocalFiles enables broad local reads; --allow / Document.Allow adds prefix-scoped exceptions; HTTP(S) requests use the selected NetworkPolicy. JavaScript is never executed, and JS-related flags are rejected as unknown options (internal/cli/cli.go:238).
